initial.chief_complaint: Itchy red welts all over my body since the day before yesterday.

presenting_complaint: Itchy red welts all over my body since the day before yesterday.
history_freetext:
Two days ago itchy raised red welts appeared on the trunk and arms, then the legs. Each welt lasts a few hours and then disappears while new ones appear in other places. Very itchy, worse in the evening.
No swelling of the lips, tongue, eyelids or throat; no difficulty breathing, no wheeze, no dizziness, no vomiting or diarrhoea, no fever, no joint pain. Never had hives before.
Had a cold with sore throat and runny nose that began five days ago and is almost over. Took ibuprofen 400 mg twice yesterday for a headache. No new foods, no new medicines other than ibuprofen, no new soap, cosmetics or detergent, no insect bites, no new pets.
Healthy; no asthma, no thyroid disease, no known allergies, no autoimmune disease. Takes only an oral contraceptive pill for years. Not planning pregnancy.
